notes.title: Big Bouncy Update
notes.notes:
It is finally time. The update we have been talking about for the past few days is here.

But what is new ?

We announced each new feature in a separate post, but here is a quick summary:

 6 new Items (4 effect and 2 controllabale Items) 
Details

Details

So what are you waiting for ? Download the update and see for yourself.
